title: Lattice dossier: an industrial dossier-terminal game site grammar - near-black ground, a 172-unit lattice crossed by both diagonals, three frame hairlines, one signal cyan for state only, a half-cut rail numeral, ghost words under the base line
summary: A near-black terminal (never pure black) ruled by three hairlines that frame every screen (y 152, y 900, x 1683: top band, stage, base band; main area and a 237-unit right rail), a 172-unit square lattice with both diagonals at 12 levels above the ground, one signal cyan used only for state, a right-rail pager whose giant wide two-digit numeral is cut to its top 55%, Latin set as a sign above or beside the CJK (wide caps over a 60-unit CJK title), a 230 x 6 cyan bar under section titles, a 112-unit ghost word sitting on the y900 line, full-screen paging with a horizontal push. No rounded corners.

provenance.case: fogwake (雾航信标 FOGWAKE): an original official site in this grammar - six full screens (index, bulletin, pilots, atlas, archive, more), a news list page, a 390-wide page, a no-figure show mode and a ?slot=1 placeholder mode with 15 image-generation task sheets - plus two in-game screens (lobby terminal, tower-defence battle HUD).
provenance.lineage: The official-site grammar of dark industrial-fantasy squad games (2020s): a near-black dossier terminal with hairline frames, a lattice ground, one cool signal colour and numbered full-screen sections. Read and measured on a live official site captured with a headless browser (screens, interaction states, the news page, the 390-wide page; computed styles and pixel samples); the captures stay private and are not shipped. Borrowed: the grammar and the measured proportions. Never borrowed: any name, logo, wordmark, character, organisation, term, slogan or picture.
provenance.borrow: Borrow grammar, never assets. Every name, mark, term, headline and picture in the case and the templates is our own (雾航信标, 信标局, 引航员, 岚汀, 潮雾); the case's pictures are code-drawn (a fog harbour with a lighthouse, an isometric chart table, particle emblems), characters are sized placeholder frames in ?slot=1 with a generation task sheet each.
provenance.rounds: template check --browser on 10 pages (six screens at 1920 x 1080, the 390-wide page, two in-game screens, the news page): 144 findings first pass, 42, 8, final 0. The first pass was mostly off-screen sections whose current slide stayed visible (visibility: visible inside a hidden parent), white text over the cyan rail numeral, ghost words without data-deco, a stroked title (-webkit-text-stroke is not hidden by the check's ground pass), Latin faces given mixed CJK copy, and a mobile-only stack laid out on the desktop. fonts query --style gothic --weight 700 covers all 285 CJK characters of the copy; Michroma, Oswald and Chakra Petch cover all of their Latin copy (fonts measure, nothing missing).
measured: Frame hairlines at y 152, y 900 (83.3%) and x 1683 (right rail 237 units, 12.3%), about rgba(255,255,255,.3) on the ground.
Lattice: squares of 172 units (vertical lines at x 137, 309, 481 ... 1512; rows 173, 345, 517) with both diagonals, line #1B1B1B on ground #0F0F0F (12 levels).

Signal cyan #18D1FF (progress segment y 902-909, computed style of nav and tags); the case uses #1FCFFF. Outside the first screen cyan covers under 3% of a screen; the first screen's cyan slab is x 0-840, y 108-1080.

Rail numeral: wide DemiBold 86.4 units in a 47.5-unit window (top 55% only), right edge 38 units in; '// 02 / 05' 18 units; screen name 18 units at 10% tracking; numeral : small line : name = 4.8 : 1 : 1.

Nav: Latin condensed 22 over CJK 14, gaps 80 units, current item both lines cyan. Section title: wide Latin 50 (or 20) over CJK 60, then a 230 x 6 cyan bar. Term rows: CJK 40 + wide Latin 20, 96-unit pitch.
Ghost word: condensed 112 units, -5% tracking, #242424, left edge 134-148, top on the y900 line.
Motion: the screen push is half done at 200 ms and complete by 350-400 ms; 18 of 20 computed transitions are 0.3 s (opacity, transform); the news carousel advances about every 5 s.

64 px: with logos masked, the six screens read as the reference's family (dark, hairline frame, one cyan) and apart from street-tape (grey and acid) and the six earlier game cases; acid-print-hud is the nearest dark pack but carries acid, not cyan, and no frame lines.

fonts.resolve: fonts query --text-file <all CJK copy> --style gothic --weight 700 resolves Noto Sans SC (the case: 285 characters, none missing); Michroma, Oswald and Chakra Petch are Latin only (fonts measure --path), so mixed strings go to head or body, never wide, narrow or mono.
fonts.licence: All roles use SIL OFL 1.1 fonts.
fonts.note: Fonts are named, not bundled. --font-dir <dir> reads coverage and embeds the faces. Michroma is very wide (about 0.95 em per cap): give its slots room.

grammar: Three hairlines frame every screen: y 152 (top band), y 900 (base band) and x 1683 (a 237-unit right rail); pictures and lists start on 152 and end on 900; the rail holds only the pager, downloads and class icons.
Ground is near-black #101112, never pure black, ruled by a 172-unit square lattice with both diagonals 12 levels above it; corner dot screens fade in from the lower corners.

One signal cyan, for state only: the current nav item and tab, the rail numeral, tags, the progress segment, a 230 x 6 bar under a section title; outside the first screen it covers under 3%. The first screen alone may carry one large cyan slab with knocked-out letters.
The rail pager: a giant wide two-digit numeral cut to its top 55%, '// 02 / 05' over its right half on a ground plate, then the screen name in wide caps at 10% tracking; numbers run from 00.
Latin is a sign: wide caps above or beside the CJK (20 or 50 over a 60-unit CJK title; terms CJK 40 + Latin 20 on one baseline); nav pairs are condensed Latin 22 over CJK 14 with 80-unit gaps.
A ghost word (condensed 112, -5%) sits on the y900 line and bleeds off the bottom; it names the screen and never carries information.
No rounded corners: tabs, buttons, thumbs and cards are square; dates read 2026 // 11 / 06.

procedural: the lattice and the three frame hairlines (lattice() and hair() in layouts-lattice.cjs)
the placeholder brand mark: lens rings crossed by one horizontal beam (no letter shapes)
recipes: Corner dot screens: materials generate --generator halftone --params '{"periodPx":8,"angleDeg":0,"coverage":0.18}' --seed 1, laid at 30-40% with a radial mask from a lower corner.

Characters and key art come from an image-generation task sheet (#311) with a painted-in blend (grade to the scene, fog wrap, a cyan rim from the brightest light); until then the slot shows its size, safe box and the boxes the UI covers, and a cut-out goes in with materials cut --mode none --finish cut.
collage: Pictures fill whole stage areas (152 to 900) or full columns; text never sits on a picture without a ground plate or a dark fade under it.
materials.sources: Everything is drawn; pictures are your own art in the image slots.

grammar: Paging is full-screen: wheel, keys, nav and the rail all move one screen; the next screen pushes in from the right over 400 ms (half way at 200 ms), the old one slides 30% left and dims.
After the push, the screen's content rises 18 units and fades in over 0.3 s, staggered by 0.1 s; all hovers are 0.3 s colour changes to cyan.
The bulletin carousel advances every 5 s with its progress segment; a term list morphs one particle figure into the next over 0.9 s.
motion.flashLimit: No flashing; the beacon beam sweeps 16 degrees over 7 s.

guidance: 64 px distinctiveness (guidance): shrink each screen to 64 px tall with the logo masked beside street-tape and the six game packs; the dark ground, the frame lines and one small cyan state should still read. A cyan larger than a state (outside the first screen) reads as a generic tech landing page instead.

The rail numeral is decoration (data-deco / a decor slot): the small line repeats the number; put a ground plate under the small line where it crosses the numeral, or the check measures white on cyan.
Off-screen sections must hide their children too: visibility: visible on a current slide inside a hidden section stays visible to the check (off-canvas).
Do not stroke a title with -webkit-text-stroke: the check's ground pass hides fill, not stroke, and measures the title against itself; fake weight with text-shadow.
Never set mixed CJK and Latin in Michroma, Oswald or Chakra Petch (glyph-coverage); split the string or use head or body.
checks.note: The browser check runs on every render (the lattice, the clipped numeral and the fades are measured in pixels).
